# This is a simple frequency table

multiple_select_table <- table(unlist(strsplit(thisData$User.Response[thisData$Question.ID == question_id], ",")))
multiple_select_table <- multiple_select_table[order(as.numeric(names(multiple_select_table)))]


for (i in seq_along(names(multiple_select_table))) {
  val <- as.numeric(names(multiple_select_table)[i])
  match_row <- responseKey$definition[responseKey$value == val & responseKey$question == question_id]
  
  if (length(match_row) == 1) {
    names(multiple_select_table)[i] <- match_row
  }
}

multiple_select_table
